signal: When the model's projected total sits more than 6 points away from the market total, fade the model and take the market side.
universe: all 30 games on the official 2026-11-17 .. 2026-11-20 slate (data/raw/official_schedule_capture_2026-11-17.json: 2026-11-17=5, 2026-11-18=12, 2026-11-19=4, 2026-11-20=9); source file data/raw/official_schedule_capture_2026-11-17.json; window rule = the newest official schedule capture, today (UTC) + up to 3 days per the project brief
exact_settlement_rule: Settle the fade side against the final combined score vs the market total. BLOCKED: the strategy requires a point-in-time market total, which does not exist in this repo (F-W07); no ticket is produced until it does. When unblocked: settlement uses the official final (quarters sum asserted).
price_status: No licensed two-sided price exists (no odds feed; F-W07). Spread/total tickets settle on the repo's paper -110 convention (stake 1.10 to win 1.00). Moneyline strategies record W/L only; unit ROI stays blank until a price exists. SGP tickets settle at the model's published joint_prob_rho as fair price.
